chunks: The hypocrites try to deceive God, but He (leads them to) deceive themselves. When they stand up for performing the service of prayer they do so indolently, only for show, and remember God but little,
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of hypocrites when they perform prayer according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nisa is often linked to the hypocrites of Medina, illustrating how their outward ritualism masked an inner spiritual void. The phrase 'God deceives them' signifies that their superficial prayers, performed with lethargy and for show, ultimately lead to their own spiritual delusion and loss of divine presence.
